channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: RedeTV! News (05/09/26) | Completo
item.description: The September 5, 2026 episode of RedeTV! News presents the main news from Brazil and the world, covering diverse topics such as economy, security, health, and politics. Among the highlights, the inauguration of the new Directory of Hospital de Amor and an interview with Amália Costa, legal director of Volkswagen do Brasil, also stood out. The content is aimed at the general public, focusing on information of national and international interest.

item.title: Flávio recria espantalho da 'interferência' nas eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, tied with Lula at 41% in a second-round scenario per Quaest, hinted on this September 7th that the electoral process could be subject to interference, without naming who or how.

item.title: Veja onde assistir Vitória x Grêmio ao vivo nesta segunda-feira (07)
item.description: The match between Vitória and Grêmio takes place this Monday (07), at 8 PM, at the Barradão stadium, in Salvador, in the 26th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship.

item.title: Quaest: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam numericamente com 41% no segundo turno
item.description: New Quaest poll released on April 7 shows a numerical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 41% in a hypothetical runoff. Survey remains inconclusive, maintaining a balanced race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro evoca a su padre para movilizar a la derecha ante las elecciones y echar a Lula y al juez Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro rallied 28,000 supporters on Paulista Avenue during Brazil's 204th Independence Day, leveraging the event to kickstart the October elections. The senator evoked his jailed father Jair Bolsonaro, criticized Lula and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and declared his aim to be the 'liberator of the homeland'. The rally featured support for Trump and foreign flags.

item.title: O pior sinal de alerta no painel do PT com a última pesquisa
item.description: The Quaest poll released on September 7th shows government disapproval rising from 48% to 50%, while approval dropped from 45% to 43%. Despite positive economic indicators, such as lower inflation and unemployment, Lula's candidacy faces warnings for not gaining expected electoral support.

item.title: Dino fala em causa própria para defender que lhe continue disponível o inquérito das fake news
item.description: Flávio Dino used his Instagram account to publicly defend Alexandre de Moraes and the continuation of the fake news investigation, arguing that lengthy judicial processes can be used as instruments of censorship and persecution, especially against critics and political opponents. He questions the impartiality of Supreme Court justices during political investigations, suggesting that the prolonged duration of these inquiries can be manipulated to favor certain groups or individuals.

item.title: Flávio lidera transferência de votos entre candidatos, aponta Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads in vote transfer in hypothetical runoff against Lula (PT). 59% of Romeu Zema (Novo) voters would support him. The former governor gained in voting intention.

item.title: Veja imagens de atos contra Moraes em várias cidades do Brasil
item.description: Protests against Minister Alexandre de Moraes took place in at least nine Brazilian capital cities on September 7, 2026, led by figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Silas Malafaia. The demonstrations gained momentum after the release of messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Moraes, drawing hundreds of thousands of people, including 34,200 in São Paulo.

item.title: Cury manda “abraço” a Mendonça e pede transparência no STF
item.description: Candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) expressed support for Minister André Mendonça and called for transparency at the STF during a public event in Copacabana, without directly mentioning other ministers. He also criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for lacking agricultural experience, positioning himself as an alternative to political polarization.

item.title: Fachin cancela reunião com OAB sobre crise no STF
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin canceled a meeting with the OAB regarding the court crisis after a PF report revealed ties between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The OAB scheduled an urgent meeting to discuss the crisis, while the Supreme Court did not disclose the reason for the cancellation.

item.title: Moraes vira principal personagem do 7 de Setembro, mas só urnas vão definir futuro do STF
item.description: The STF crisis intensified after the September 7th demonstrations, with Alexandre De Moraes becoming the main focus of the dispute. With Lula and Flávio tied at 41% in voter intention, the wave of dissatisfaction falls on the minister rather than the PT candidate. The scenario remains static, awaiting the election results to define the future of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Veja como foi a segunda-feira (7) dos presidenciáveis
item.description: On Monday (7), the presidential candidates held events commemorating September 7, with speeches focused on security, economy, and women's inclusion in politics. Flávio Bolsonaro stood out by criticizing the STF and proposing tough measures such as reducing the age of criminal responsibility and chemical castration for rapists.

item.title: Manifestação de Flávio reúne 28,5 mil pessoas na Paulista, estima USP
item.description: The event organized by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Paulista Avenue gathered 28,500 people, according to estimates by USP/Cebrap and More in Common. The mobilization took place on September 7th holiday, showing a decrease compared to the previous year, when 42,200 people attended the same location.

item.title: Fachin cancela reunião com OAB em meio à crise no STF
item.description: Amid the STF crisis, the court's president, Minister Edson Fachin, canceled a meeting with OAB president Beto Simonetti, which was to address investigations involving ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça regarding the Daniel Vorcaro case. Despite the postponement, Simonetti called an extraordinary meeting and emphasized the need for rigorous investigation of any misconduct by ministers.

item.title: Robô humanóide do Exército bate continência a Lula em desfile do 7 de Setembro
item.description: During the September 7th parade, a humanoid robot from the Military Institute of Engineering (IME) saluted President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, drawing attention on social media. The robot, part of AI and robotics research, was showcased in the military technology section. The government emphasized national sovereignty as the central theme of the event.

item.title: No 7 de setembro, pesquisa mostra que Flávio não avança, Lula é que anda de marcha ré
item.description: A Quaest poll on September 7 shows Lula losing ground, tying technically with Flavio Bolsonaro in the runoff (41% to 41%). Government approval fell to 43%, with disapproval at 50%, and the economy, particularly household debt, emerges as the main obstacle to Lula's fourth term.

item.title: STF forma maioria contra soltura de Bolsonaro
item.description: Two of the three ministers of the STF's First Chamber have already rejected the habeas corpus requesting the release of former President Jair Bolsonaro, securing a majority against his release before the trial is concluded. Carmen Lúcia, the rapporteur, and Cristiano Zanin voted against the request, with only Flávio Dino's vote remaining.

item.title: Na Avenida Paulista, Flávio Bolsonaro associa Moraes a Lula e diz que indicará ‘5 ministros’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro spoke on Paulista Avenue calling for the impeachment of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and claimed he will appoint five justices if elected, linking Moraes to Lula's government. He also defended conservative stances such as harsher penalties for crimes and labeling criminal factions as terrorists.

item.title: Eduardo Leite sobre crescimento de Augusto Cury: ‘Apetite por algo diferente’
item.description: The governor of Rio Grande do Sul, Eduardo Leite (PSD), highlighted Augusto Cury’s (Avante) rise in the presidential race as evidence of demand for alternatives, while noting lingering resistance in a polarized context. He added that Rock in Rio boosts the local economy, creating over 20,000 temporary jobs.

item.title: Fio do Professor Felipe Nunes: análise da pesquisa Quaest para presidente de 7 de setembro
item.description: The Quaest survey released on September 7 shows Lula leading the first round with 36%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 29%. In a simulated second round, the two candidates tie at 41% each, highlighting political polarization and 50% disapproval of Lula's administration.

item.title: Renan diz que liderança de Lula e Flávio é “prisão mental”
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) labeled Lula and Flávio’s poll leads as 'mental prison,' criticizing voters who repeat the past. He attacked Augusto Cury, calling his campaign 'rise of cowardice,' and warned of authoritarian or oligarchic governments. Renan also called for the arrest of Supreme Court justices, particularly Moraes and Toffoli.

item.title: Quaest: desaprovação de Lula preocupa aliados, que defendem mudanças
item.description: Lula's disapproval rating reached 50% in the Quaest poll, alarming allies and signaling low reelection odds in 2026. Approval dropped from 47% to 43% since July, while criticism grew, especially among men, youth, and traditionally supportive regions. Factors like household debt and controversies involving Moraes and Vorcaro may be contributing to the erosion.

item.title: Vera Magalhães: 'Movimento revelado pela Quaest é muito negativo para Lula'; assista à análise em vídeo
item.description: The latest Quaest poll shows Lula tied with Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff, with both candidates facing high rejection rates. Columnist Vera Magalhães notes that the negative fallout from the STF crisis particularly impacts Lula, given the strong association between Minister Moraes and the Petrobras government.

item.title: Quaest: eleitores de Cury, Renan Santos, Caiado e Zema migram mais para Flávio Bolsonaro em eventual 2º turno
item.description: The Quaest poll shows that voters from right-wing figures like Cury, Caiado, Renan Santos, and Zema tend to shift toward Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential runoff against Lula, resulting in a statistical tie. The survey was conducted between September 3 and 6, before new revelations in the Master case.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula não tem ‘autoridade moral’ para falar de patriotismo e soberania
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticizes Lula, saying he lacks moral authority to speak on patriotism and sovereignty during Independence Day, accusing him of returning Brazil to crime, corruption, and mistreatment. He also reiterates his pledge to appoint only women to the Supreme Court.

item.title: Em meio à crise no STF, preocupação com corrupção cresce seis pontos e fica em 2º entre maiores problemas do país, diz Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll shows corruption concern rose from 14% to 20% among voters, driven by STF crisis involving Moraes and Mendonça. Corruption tied with economy as second major concern, behind only violence at 31%.

item.title: Zema é hostilizado ao caminhar na Paulista durante ato do 7 de Setembro
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) was confronted by protesters while walking on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo on Monday (9/7), during the event organized by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign (PL). A video shows a man questioning whether Zema was leveraging the crowd, with the politician responding 'Democracy, democracy'. Zema's campaign held its rally in the morning, and Flávio's commenced around 3 PM, both showing support for former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 55% de rejeição e Lula, 53%
item.description: New Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading rejection rates (55%) in the presidential race, followed by Lula (PT) at 53%. Voting intentions indicate Lula at 36% and Flávio at 29%, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Lula e Flávio empatam no 2º turno, diz Quaest
item.description: A new Quaest poll commissioned by Globo shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the second round, with 41% voting intention for each. Among interviewed voters, 13% intend to vote blank or null, and 5% remain undecided.

item.title: Ato de Flávio Bolsonaro confirma resiliência do bolsonarismo, mas sem força disruptiva de anos atrás
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's rally on September 7th in São Paulo confirmed bolsonarismo's resilience but drew limited attendance compared to previous events, reflecting voter apathy. The campaign has been marked by low enthusiasm, with similar low turnout observed at events for other candidates such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Haddad.

item.title: Quaest: Lula e Flávio empatam com 41% em eventual 2º turno
item.description: President Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are tied at 41% in a potential runoff, according to a Quaest poll. Lula holds a numerical lead over other tested opponents such as Zema and Caiado.

item.title: Valdemar Costa Neto: com Flávio eleito, Bolsonaro estará com a gente no dia seguinte
item.description: PL leader Valdemar Costa Neto claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro's election to the presidency would lead to Jair Bolsonaro's release, who is currently ineligible and under house arrest. The statement strengthens the PL's alliance with the former president.

item.title: Lula e Flávio aparecem empatados em 41% no segundo turno, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 7 shows that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are tied at 41% in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff.

item.title: Quaest: Lula e Flávio empatam com 41% no segundo turno; Cury vai de 10% para 8% no primeiro
item.description: The Quaest poll shows Lula and Flávio tied at 41% in the second round, while Cury drops from 10% to 8%. Psychiatrist Augusto Cury (Avante) decreased slightly within the margin of error in the latest round of the survey.

item.title: Rejeição a Flávio Bolsonaro é de 55% e a Lula, de 53%, aponta pesquisa Quaest
item.description: Quaest survey reveals significant voter rejection for both Lula (53%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (55%), remaining stable since September. Both candidates face distrust, highlighting pre-election polarization ahead of 2026.

item.title: Flávio usa ato de 7 de Setembro para transformar ações contra Moraes em combustível de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leveraged the September 7th event on Paulista Avenue to turn revelations involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro into campaign fuel. With less than a month before the first round, the senator aims to mobilize his base and attack the Supreme Court minister's image. The strategy seeks to highlight actions against alleged judicial influence in politics.

item.title: Quaest: 33% dizem que a renda não aumentou no último ano e 21%, que subiu menos que o custo de vida
item.description: Quaest poll shows 33% of Brazilians say household income did not increase last year, while 21% report it rose less than the cost of living. Lula leads with 36% of first-round voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 29%. Income perception significantly influences voting: Lula leads among those saying income rose more than cost of living (76%), while Flávio leads among those saying income did not increase (34%).

item.title: Boneco inflável de Trump segura Lula preso em ato na Paulista
item.description: A São Paulo protest attended by an estimated 34,200 people, organized by Flávio Bolsonaro, featured an inflatable Trump doll holding a prisoner-style Lula figure. The event intensified attacks on the Supreme Court following leaked messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Minister Moraes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai focar em segurança pública e aumento do custo de vida
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro focuses on public security and rising cost of life as key campaign themes, criticizing the Lula government. A Genial/Quaest survey shows a technical tie between the two candidates in the second round, with 41% of voting intentions each.

item.title: Alcolumbre prega união enquanto é pressionado por impeachment de Moraes
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, president of the Senate, advocated for dialogue and unity during an event attended by Lula, Fachin, and Moraes, while facing pressure to initiate impeachment proceedings against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Meanwhile, allies of Bolsonaro, including Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Bolsonaro, organized protests demanding Moraes' removal.

item.title: Ato de Flávio na Paulista mira Lula e mostra união do bolsonarismo contra pizza no STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held the largest rally of his campaign on Paulista Avenue, leveraging the Vorcaro message scandal and the Banco Master case to directly attack Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and unify the far-right against the STF. The event emphasized criticism of Minister Alexandre de Moraes and called for independent investigations, aiming to counteract leaks and judicial actions that could damage his candidacy.

item.title: Quaest: Lula lidera no primeiro turno com 36% contra Flávio que registra 29%
item.description: A September 2026 Quaest poll shows President Lula (PT) leading with 36% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 29%. The survey interviewed 2,004 people between September 3 and 6, with a 2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Fernanda Bolsonaro usa jaqueta de R$ 999 em ato na Paulista
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro wore a Zara leather jacket costing R$999 at the September 7th demonstration on Paulista Avenue, alongside PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro. The rally featured criticism of Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes and drew fewer attendees compared to previous years.

item.title: Rejeição a Lula se mantém em 53%, e a de Flávio Bolsonaro vai a 55%, mostra Quaest
item.description: Rejection of President Lula remains at 53%, while Flávio Bolsonaro's rises to 55%, according to a Genial/Quaest survey. The variation is within the two percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Quaest: 32% dizem que Lula e PT vencerem é o melhor resultado da eleição presidencial; para 24%, a volta da família Bolsonaro
item.description: A Quaest survey shows 32% of Brazilians view Lula and PT winning as the best electoral outcome in 2026, while 24% prefer the return of the Bolsonaro family. With a two-point margin of error, the data reveals regional divides, with stronger PT support in the Northeast and Bolsonaro backing in the South.

item.title: Quaest: 50% desaprovam o governo Lula e 43% aprovam, aponta pesquisa
item.description: A Quaest poll released on September 7 shows that 50% of Brazilians disapprove of President Lula's government, while 43% approve. The survey was conducted between September 3 and 6, during the STF crisis, with a margin of error of two percentage points and 95% confidence.

item.title: Ação contra lei que beneficiou filho de Arthur Lira fracassa no STF
item.description: Minister Cármen Lúcia of the STF rejected a lawsuit filed by the Democracia Cristã party against a law modifying the minimum age verification rules for elected candidates, which benefited Alvinho Lira (son of Arthur Lira). The STF did not address the case's merits due to the party's lack of representation in Congress, keeping the legislation valid.

item.title: Quaest: Lula e Flávio empatam numericamente no segundo turno
item.description: Lula and Flávio tie at 41% in hypothetical runoff vote, according to Quaest poll conducted September 3-6. Both held steady from the previous round.

item.title: Ato de Flávio Bolsonaro na av. Paulista vira protesto contra Moraes e reúne quase 30 mil: 'Última semana me fez estar aqui'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's event on Paulista Avenue turned into a protest against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, gathering around 30,000 people. The mobilization, organized by allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro, had lower attendance than similar events from the previous year. Flávio stated that the "last week" motivated him to take part in the demonstration.
